title: For a complex free pseudo-product fundamental graded Lie algebra with positive generator dimensions m,n and depth at least two, a nonzero degree-one structure-preserving prolongation forces depth two and the simple graded Lie algebra sl(m+n+1) with adjacent marked roots m,m+1
author: Tomoaki Yatsui
work: On Free Pseudo-Product Fundamental Graded Lie Algebras
source_version: Official SIGMA 8 (2012) article 038, DOI 10.3842/SIGMA.2012.038; journal PDF and native TeX acquired 2026-10-01, exact bytes pinned by SHA256
difficulty_reason: The proof constructs the free pseudo-product quotient and its structure-preserving derivations, then uses the degree-two/three module and centralizer analysis to constrain the positive Tanaka prolongation. It rules out every higher-depth case by explicit iterated Jacobi identities and a nonzero determinant before identifying the depth-two simple grading. This is a global classification for two positive generator dimensions, rather than a direct application of a standard one-generator prolongation list.

proof_review.note: Select only part(2) of Theorem8.1, identical to introduction TheoremII. Read complete free-Lie universal construction and two-generator bracket support in Sections2-4, full pseudo-product quotient/derivation construction8.2, Tanaka finite-dimensionality Lemma8.1, all degree-two/three module and centralizer support8.3/8.4, Example8.2, and the full higher-depth contradiction in8.1(2). The relevant prolongation has degree-zero derivations preserving BOTH e and f; it is not the unrestricted prolongation g(m), whose contact/Cartan exceptions are in excluded part(1). Prior Tanaka/Yamaguchi simple-gradation and first-kind structure results are explicitly published background, with exact uses retained. The author provides the full iterated Jacobi expressions and nonzero 2x2 determinant. No automorphism theorem, free one-summand classification, contact example or individual depth case is counted separately.

original_metadata.statement_scope: Theorem8.1 part(2) only, equivalently TheoremII: over C, m,n positive, mu>=2, negative algebra m is free pseudo-product of type(m,n,mu) with g_-1=e direct-sum f, dim(e)=m,dim(f)=n and [e,e]=[f,f]=0, with the stated universal property. g is the Tanaka prolongation whose g_0 is all graded derivations preserving e and f. If g_1 is nonzero, mu=2 and g is the finite-dimensional simple graded algebra of type(A_(m+n),{alpha_m,alpha_(m+1)}), i.e. sl(m+n+1) with those adjacent marked roots. No classification of the unrestricted prolongation or automorphism group is selected.
original_metadata.editorial_warning: Source annotation, with author bytes unchanged: in the proof on page15 eta is printed as belonging to f-star, but the displayed defining coefficient eta(Z) and both ensuing identities evaluate it on Z,X in e. Those authored formulas determine the coefficient domain used in the proof; no alternative bracket formula is supplied. Proposition8.3(3) prints a degree-three formula without a depth qualifier; the selected proof uses it only in its explicitly mu>=3 branch, while the mu=2 conclusion uses degree-two data and Example8.2.
